text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to do tasks that normally need human intelligence. Machine learning is a part of AI. It lets computers learn from data and improve without direct programming. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning. It uses large neural networks to solve very complex problems, like recognising faces or understanding speech. Today, AI is everywhere in daily life. It helps us with voice assistants, movie recommendations, spam filters, and navigation apps. AI also supports doctors in finding diseases and helps banks stop fraud. In short, AI makes many everyday tasks faster and easier.
